stories.title: More choice or anti-intellectual? Albertans mixed on new high school grad requirements
stories.summary: Albertans are still wrapping their heads around the incoming requirements to graduate high school that include more gym class and fewer core academic courses taken to the 30-level.

stories.title: Alberta proposes data centre buffer zone near homes, some farms and irrigated land
stories.summary: The Alberta bill setting new rules around major data centres and where they can be built comes at a time when 70 proposals are being considered for development in the province.

stories.title: Bragg Creek Community Association gets financial relief from cyber theft
stories.summary: Rocky View County has stepped in to help keep the Bragg Creek Community Association afloat, after a recent cyber theft left the Alberta non-profit's bank accounts empty.

stories.title: Heavy snow creates treacherous road conditions in Calgary, southern Alberta
stories.summary: As heavy snow fell overnight Wednesday, Calgary police said it responded to more than 60 collisions, including 16 with injuries and eight hit-and-runs, between midnight and 8 a.m.

stories.title: Canadian women’s flag football team to hold camp
stories.summary: It's back to work for Rachel Lessard and the Canadian women's flag football team.

stories.title: Preston Manning-led report says Western Canada can unite, gain power within Confederation
stories.summary: The report's recommendations broadly push for more sovereignty across the four westernmost provinces and suggest ways they can better communicate their demands to Ottawa.

stories.title: 7 bird flu cases across Prairies linked to Saskatchewan poultry show
stories.summary: Seven cases of highly pathogenic avian influenza have been detected in the Prairie provinces after an exposure at a Saskatchewan poultry show earlier this month.

stories.title: 3 exemptions added to new Alberta driver’s licence rules amid renewal headaches
stories.summary: Exemptions will be considered for long-established Albertans with historical document issues, those with 'exceptional hardships' and people waiting on the federal government.

stories.title: Auditor general can’t commit to timeline on Alberta health contract corruption probe
stories.summary: The probe is among multiple investigations launched after the former head of Alberta Health Services in 2025 made allegations of corruption in multimillion-dollar health deals.

stories.title: IIHF says it was the target of a cyberattack, takes website offline
stories.summary: The IIHF said it was investigating the source of the cyberattack and was working to restore its systems. Its platforms would be back online soon, it says.
